title: Anticancer efficacy of thiazole-naphthyl derivatives targeting DNA: Synthesis, crystal structure, density functional theory, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics studies.
authors: Aher, Abhishek; Bera, Pradip; Brandao, Paula; Sharda, Saphy; Khatua, Sabyasachi; Manna, Sunil Kumar; Manhas, Anu; Bera, Pulakesh
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟探究小分子配体与DNA的结合模式，属于广义蛋白质-DNA互作（实为配体-DNA）且方法可迁移，但对象非TF-DNA体系，故评5分。
abstract: Two newly synthesized ligands, 1-((2-(4-(4-methoxyphenyl)thiazol-2-yl)hydrazono)methyl)naphthalen-2-ol (HL1) and 1-((2-(4-(naphthalen-1-yl)thiazol-2-yl)hydrazono)methyl)naphthalen-2-ol (HL2) were characterized using spectroscopy and single X-ray crystallography. Both belong to triclinic systems with space groups P21/c (HL1) and P-1 (HL2), exhibiting planar structures. Biological assays revealed significant antitumor activity, with HL2 showing significant antitumor activity against HepG2 cells (IC(50): 3.2 +/- 0.1 muM) compared to HL1 (IC(50): 7.3 +/- 0.3 muM). Mechanistic studies revealed HL2 induces apoptosis, while HL1 triggers necroptosis, and both were non-toxic to peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC). UV-Vis titration showed that HL2 binds more strongly to DNA (K(b): 1.08 +/- 0.215 x 10(5) M(-1)) than HL1 (K(b): 1.02 +/- 0.155 x 10(4) M(-1)), attributed to stronger naphthyl chromophore stacking with DNA base pairs. Supporting this, hypochromic effects, circular dichroism spectra, and increased DNA viscosity suggest HL2 is a moderate intercalator, while HL1 functions as a groover binder. Docking studies revealed that in HL2, an additional naphthyl group enhances DNA binding affinity, explaining its superior efficacy. Molecular dynamics simulations further confirmed the stable binding of both ligands to DNA in the biological environment. These experimental and theoretical findings highlight the superior binding affinity of HL2 and its potential as a promising candidate for cancer therapy.
abstract_zh: 两种新合成的配体，1-((2-(4-(4-甲氧基苯基)噻唑-2-基)肼基)甲基)萘-2-醇 (HL1) 和 1-((2-(4-(萘-1-基)噻唑-2-基)肼基)甲基)萘-2-醇 (HL2)，通过光谱学和单晶X射线晶体学进行了表征。两者均属于三斜晶系，空间群分别为P21/c (HL1) 和 P-1 (HL2)，并呈现平面结构。生物学测定显示显著的抗肿瘤活性，其中HL2对HepG2细胞表现出显著抗肿瘤活性（IC(50)：3.2 ± 0.1 μM），而HL1的IC(50)为7.3 ± 0.3 μM。机制研究表明，HL2诱导细胞凋亡，而HL1触发坏死性凋亡，且两者对外周血单核细胞（PBMC）均无毒性。紫外-可见滴定显示，HL2与DNA的结合更强（K(b)：1.08 ± 0.215 × 10^5 M^(-1)），而HL1的K(b)为1.02 ± 0.155 × 10^4 M^(-1)，这归因于萘基发色团与DNA碱基对之间更强的堆叠作用。支持这一结论的是，减色效应、圆二色光谱以及DNA粘度的增加表明HL2是一种中等强度的嵌入剂，而HL1则作为沟槽结合剂发挥作用。对接研究表明，在HL2中，额外的萘基增强了DNA结合亲和力，这解释了其更优的功效。分子动力学模拟进一步证实了两种配体在生物环境中与DNA的稳定结合。这些实验和理论发现突显了HL2优越的结合亲和力及其作为癌症治疗有前景候选药物的潜力。
